title: Farm Borewell Distance Rule Helper
problem: Neighboring farmers fight heated arguments because someone dug a new borewell too close to an old well, drying up both water sources.
idea: A distance checker. The farmer types the distance between the new and old borewell and the rule distance told by the officer, and it shows if it is safe. Flyers remind farmers to ask permission first.

widgets.heading: 📏 Is the New Borewell Far Enough?
widgets.intro: The rule distance below is only a sample. Ask the Groundwater Department, Agriculture Officer or Tahsildar office for the real rule in your area.

inputs.label: Measured distance from old well / borewell (metres)
Rule distance told by the officer (metres) – sample

widgets.formula: if (typeof dist !== 'number' || typeof rule !== 'number' || dist < 0 || rule <= 0) return null; var gap = dist - rule; if (gap >= 0) return {msg: 'OK: ' + gap + ' metres more than the rule distance.', tip: 'Still take permission from the officer before digging.', level: 'good'}; return {msg: 'TOO CLOSE by ' + (-gap) + ' metres!', tip: 'Do not dig here. It can dry up both wells and cause fights.', level: 'bad'};

items.title: Ask before digging
items.text: Check rules and permission at the Groundwater / Revenue office first.
items.te: తవ్వే ముందు భూగర్భ జల శాఖ / రెవెన్యూ ఆఫీసులో అనుమతి అడగండి.

items.title: Talk to neighbours
items.text: Tell neighbour farmers before digging. Sit and talk calmly.
items.te: తవ్వే ముందు పక్క రైతులకు చెప్పండి. ప్రశాంతంగా మాట్లాడండి.

items.title: Recharge the ground
items.text: Make a recharge pit near the borewell so rainwater goes back underground.
items.te: వర్షపు నీరు భూమిలోకి ఇంకేలా బోరు దగ్గర ఇంకుడు గుంత తవ్వండి.

items.title: Use drip
items.text: Drip irrigation uses less water, so wells last longer.

questions.q: Why should borewells not be dug too close together?
options: They pull water from the same place and can dry up
questions.why: Close borewells share the same underground water and both can go dry.

questions.q: Where do you confirm the distance rule?
questions.why: Only official offices know the current rules.
Recharge pits send rainwater back into the ground.

how: Ask Gemini why borewells too close together dry up, in simple words.
Ask the Agriculture Extension Officer or Groundwater office about the real distance rules in our mandal.
Open Canva and choose a flyer template with water colours.
Add a simple picture of two wells with a measured gap and 'Ask before you dig'.
Add the water-saving tips and the office to contact.
Print and share at the Rythu Vedika or farmers' meeting.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Explain in simple Telugu and English why digging a new borewell too close to an existing well can dry both up. Give 4 tips for farmers to avoid fights and save groundwater. Tell them to confirm the distance rules with the Groundwater Department.
